findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_towns, get_town, town_feed, surf_cams, social_posts · Private data: surf_forecast, social_posts · Public sink: nearby_places, town_feed, surf_forecast, surf_now, social_posts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_towns, get_town, town_feed, surf_cams, social_posts · Private data: surf_forecast, social_posts · Public sink: nearby_places, town_feed, surf_forecast, surf_now, social_posts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
